sources.name: Meralco
sources.how: Rates archive page lists each month's PDFs; the residential-bills table prints PHP/kWh per consumption level.

sources.name: CELCOR
sources.how: The archive page is a JavaScript app; its data comes from a JSON API, found by watching the page's network requests. The residential-bills PDF prints the total bill per consumption level.

sources.name: Tarlac Electric (TEI)
sources.how: One page per month embeds the month's rate schedule PDF, which prints each charge per customer class.

sources.name: AEC (Angeles Electric)
sources.how: Monthly bill insert: one image (also posted on Facebook) giving the change in the residential rate and its components. Read from the image by OCR and a vision model; checked against the change in DOE's figures.

sources.name: CEDC (Clark Electric)
sources.how: Rate schedule and generation-cost tables published as images. Read by OCR and a vision model; the generation charge is compared directly, and the schedule's charges before tax set a floor DOE's all-in rate must clear.

not_automated.name: 54 utilities linked to Facebook
not_automated.why: Facebook pages can't be read without logging in, and Meta's terms forbid automated collection without its permission. Until a sanctioned route exists (Graph API Page Public Content Access, utilities connecting their Pages, or a DOE filing), a person saves the month's rate post into data/inbox/<utility_id>/ and the same image reader takes it from there.
